description.value: Hotel Grand Pacific is a 10-storey full-service hotel on Belleville Street in downtown Victoria, steps from the Inner Harbour and the BC Legislature. The property offers multiple on-site dining venues, an Athletic Club, and event facilities, making it one of the more substantial independent hotels in the city core. Touring cyclists will find it centrally placed for exploring Victoria's extensive waterfront cycling routes.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: wall_loops (9 spaces) at 54m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content was successfully fetched but rendered almost entirely as navigation menus, yielding very little substantive amenity detail beyond confirming the address (463 Belleville St, Victoria, BC V8V 1X3) and that the hotel has on-site dining venues (Fathom, Courtyard Café, In Room Dining) and an Athletic Club. OSM contributes internet_access=wlan and bar=yes, but per rules these cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration, which the scraped text does not provide. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere in either source.
concerns: Website pages rendered almost entirely as navigation chrome with no substantive body content — amenity details could not be extracted; a manual review of the site's Amenities or FAQ pages would be needed to confirm cyclist-specific services.
